entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It looks like the Treasure has materialized,[n]just as planned.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is difficult to determine its exact shape[n]from here though...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's part of the fun of stealin' it. We can[n]find out what it is afterward.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll begin our operation in front of the[n]crane device. Let's go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Where'd Madarame go?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We can worry about that later. For now,[n]we must leave this place.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, no way! It's not openin'!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Seriously!?

entries.speaker: Security Guard Shadow
entries.en: I heard sounds coming from the crane![n]Check up above!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wh-Wh-What do we do!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You don't got a plan about how to get[n]outta here!? What kinda master thief[n]are you!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In any case, let us search for another[n]way out. We must escape!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Leaving this way will be[n]impossible. We must hurry[n]and search for another exit!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, Joker. We need to go see if Mona[n]pulled it off first.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, a window! But, where's it go?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now is no time to be lost in thought.[n]We must go!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems this window leads outside...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The operation is more important right[n]now. Let's head to the crane and get it[n]started!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Does this window lead outside?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What're you doing!? We have to[n]hurry or—

entries.speaker: Security Guard Shadow
entries.en: There! The trespasser's up there![n]Lock down the control room and[n]get them!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wh-Wh-What do we do!? They're[n]already here!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There's no time to contemplate.[n]We must escape—now!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Looks like the wire's already gettin'[n]wound up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We should hurry and see if Mona was[n]successful!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We don't have any business with that[n]now! Let's escape!
